text:
liam (Acme): hey team — after yesterday's model push our assistant answers are noticeably slimmer. customers say responses feel more directive and lose small polite hedges and extra context. not a content correctness issue, more tone and helpfulness.

liam (Acme): quick example: prompt = 'help me draft an email to postpone a meeting because of illness, keep it friendly'. previously assistant gave 4–6 sentence draft with a closing line. after the bump it returned a 2-sentence note, more blunt. attaching exact requests below.

emma (Support): thanks for the report, liam. can you paste the actual request + both outputs (pre/post) if you have them? also which model id/version are you hitting and when did you first see it? :thinking_face:

liam (Acme): sure. observed right after deploy around 2026-01-12 03:20 UTC. model header in requests is: 
```
{
  "model": "redwood-rt-3-small@v2.7.1",
  "temperature": 0.3
}
```
previous (from logs 2026-01-11):
"Hi Sam, I’m sorry but I need to postpone our meeting due to illness. Could we reschedule for later this week? Thanks for understanding — looking forward to catching up."

current (2026-01-12):
"I need to postpone our meeting due to illness. Please propose another time."

liam (Acme): customer says reaction rate and downstream replies dropped after that shorter wording. not a hard outage, but hurting UX.

emma (Support): got it. can you share a request id for one of the calls? also approximate token counts for prompt/response?

liam (Acme): sample request id: rwl-req-9b72f1. tokens: prompt ~42, prior output ~38, current output ~18.

noah (Eng-ML): tagging in. thanks for concrete samples. two quick hypotheses: 1) a change in generation hyperparams (top_k/stop/penalty) with the roll, 2) model weight delta that favors brevity. did you use streaming or non-streaming? any reranking / post-processing on your side?

liam (Acme): non-streaming, no downstream rerank. identical client code.

sophia (SRE): deploy-bot shows a canary->full rollout at 2026-01-12 03:05 UTC for redwood-rt-3-small@v2.7.1. attaching deploy snippet.

deploy-bot: Deployed redwood-rt-3-small@v2.7.1 to production (canary 02:45 UTC -> roll 03:05 UTC). Config: default sampling, no forced temp overrides.

noah (Eng-ML): ok. can you replay the exact request with header X-Debug-Mode: true and we’ll pull full cache + latency traces? if you can forward the response body we can diff logits/stop signals. also curious if this manifests only for social/soft prompts or across the board.

emma (Support): liam, asking customer to replay and send the raw response. for now we should run a small eval: 50 random prompts from your corpus before/after model and measure avg reply length, hedging token frequency (words like 'maybe', 'perhaps', 'I recommend', 'you might'), and user engagement delta. can you provide a small sample set?

liam (Acme): will do, sending a 60-prompt sample in a separate upload. also turning on debug header now and will paste one raw response when available.

noah (Eng-ML): thanks. I'll run an internal quick A/B on this model vs previous checkpoint against that sample and post preliminary stats here. if we see a systematic drop we'll open a rollback or a targeted tuning patch (adjust sampling bias or reintroduce polite-response objective).

sophia (SRE): meanwhile i'll check inference latency and batching patterns for the window around the roll — sometimes a perf tweak to batching can shorten outputs due to early EOS heuristics.

emma (Support): appreciate it. liam — flagging your SE for faster updates. will follow up when we have diffs. :+1:

liam (Acme): cheers, thanks. customer is sensitive to tone so rapid turnaround would help.

noah (Eng-ML): preliminary A/B queued — expect numbers in ~45m. if anyone sees other customers reporting similar "slim" phrasing, drop them here so we can correlate.

emma (Support): adding a short ticket to track this regression and SLA impact. ticket id: SUP-2026-4923.

liam (Acme): SUP-2026-4923 noted. thanks everyone."
